title: The Vector of Sector Nine Again
author: Ivo Voss
blurb: Mara Sterling, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
